message.content:
This is a plastic bag of polymers of ethylene, so it falls under HTSUS 3923.21 (sacks and bags, including cones, of polymers of ethylene). The 80 percent polyethylene by weight places it in that subheading.

The laminate structure with OPP and metallized PET raises the question of whether it is a "sheeting" laminate, but because the article is a finished bag, heading 3923 applies.

Within 3923.21, the statistical suffixes are:
- 3923.21.00 is the base subheading.
- 3923.21.0085 is "Other" (the 10-digit number, 3923.21.0085, covers other sacks and bags of ethylene polymers).
- 3923.21.0095 is also listed in some schedule versions.

The bag has an integral extruded closure, and CBP rulings on similar zipper-type bags often classify them in 3923.21.0085. I am recalling those rulings from memory and have not checked them.
